scope: S3 case C4-I: C4's drive, then ReliefIsolationClose at a stated time, then a hold of 600 s. Owner-approved 7 November 2026, as lane RESTART proposed them. No line states a pressure the hold must reach, by the owner's approval of that proposal
from: ld01-s3-cases-c4-r5: the clock, the malfunction, the operator turbine trip, the volume classes and the common rules; its ends do not apply
disclosure: the recovery has no CMT or PRHR flow (rule J: requests only) and no return to power; stroke, supply and valve form are labelled judgement

C4I.composition: a packet composing the valve, and the declared DC section (LD01_DC=on): the close is guarded by its supply

stepping.rule: the unit's own stepping, no cap, as C4

O1.action: the close command is accepted with ACT.A supplying, and the valve is shut one stroke after it
O1.number: stroke 2 s, the valve's fence, labelled judgement

O2.action: true relief flow is zero from the shut instant to the end of the hold, in the receipts

O3.action: roof pressure at the end of the hold exceeds roof pressure at the shut instant, with no reseat or later opening of the relief

O4.action: the vapor zone's mass at the end of the hold exceeds its mass at the shut instant

N1.action: vapor in the core or loop cells at any accepted step
N1.cells: every regular cell but the block's excluded cells, SURGE and PZR, as C4.O4, and the head, HOUSING.MAIN and HOUSING.NECK, which are neither core nor loop

N2.action: a named end or a failure before the hold ends

N3.action: a lift-off of a seated rod

N4.action: a relief or isolation event not commanded

M1.action: pressure and level against time; the pressure rate at the end of the hold

M2.action: the S signal's reset time, if any; CMT and PRHR requests

M3.action: NECK's liquid minimum and NECK's vapor at the end

M4.action: the most negative vapor mass at any exhaustion's root

gates.cost: worst frame, worst 0.5 s, worst 2.5 s and lag by ld01-cost on the owner's 31 October rule, free stepping, the ungated drive
gates.refinement: as C4's refinement in ld01-s3-cases-c4-r5: the named outputs, operator grade, no cap
